name: Kozomi Chikage
source: Manager of the dormitory where [url=/c10457]Haruto[/url] lives in. Chikage is a calm, generous and considerate woman, she holds her tenants of great importance, and is very attached to them. After finding out that Haruto is living with [url=/c10367]Ayano[/url], and taking their situation and Ayano's politeness into account, she overlooks the matter.
